summary: Iteration 2 retest after iteration 1 fixes. Backend 25/25 pytest PASS (100%). /api/checkout/status/{session_id} now returns HTTP 200 with graceful DB fallback when Stripe retrieval fails (status='initiated', payment_status='pending'). Frontend: ProductPage size toast fix verified via Playwright (toast 'Choisissez une taille' fires, cart NOT incremented; after size M selected, drawer opens with 1 item). Zero Radix DialogTitle/DialogContent a11y warnings remaining on product/cart/header/filters drawers. Zero console errors across homepage, shop, product, cart flows. Both issues from iteration 1 are RESOLVED.
critical_code_review_comments: Note observed during regression (pre-existing, out of iteration 2 scope): cart state appears not persisted across full page reloads (navigating directly to /panier after a quick-add shows empty cart). Likely Zustand store without persist middleware. Works fine in SPA navigation but worth adding persist to localStorage for robustness.
server.py checkout_status fallback is sound — consider also updating payment_transactions.updated_at on each poll for observability.
Still convention: CORSMiddleware added after include_router; works but usually registered before routes.
test_credentials: No auth; guest checkout. Stripe test key sk_test_emergent configured in backend/.env. Stripe redirect not followed in tests.
seed_data_creation: Additional TEST_Marie contact_messages row created by test_contact_valid. Prior iteration test rows preserved. No cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration 1 HIGH/CRITICAL fixes are verified. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_baume_api.py is stable (25/25 pass). ProductPage size validation and DialogTitle sr-only headers are in place. Cart drawer uses [data-testid=cart-drawer] and header shows [data-testid=cart-count]. If future tests need cart persistence across reloads, consider Zustand persist middleware — currently a soft limitation but not an iteration 2 defect.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — this iteration is a retest; both previously reported defects are fixed. Backend fix: server.py checkout_status wraps Stripe call in try/except and falls back to tx fields from payment_transactions, returning HTTP 200 with status/payment_status. Frontend fix: ProductPage useEffect no longer pre-selects sizes[0]; size state remains null until user selects, so !size validation in validateAddToCart correctly triggers the sonner toast.
